comment: Rapport does some of what other mods already do, and two mods doing the same
job to the same actor do not add up -- they fight. The clearest case is
overlays: CumOverlays applies its sets on AAF's own 300-second timer, and that
timer removes TEMPLATES. Rapport's sets draw from the same templates, so
CumOverlays' countdown would strip an overlay Rapport had just applied, and the
user would see cum vanish five minutes into a twelve-hour window with nothing
in any log to explain it.
So Rapport stops those quests while it owns the feature. Automatic, but never
secret: it is checked before it is acted on, every change is named in
Rapport.log, and turning the feature off starts them again. Nothing is deleted
and no file is touched -- the mod stays installed and its assets are exactly
A quest that is already stopped is left alone, and a plugin that is not
installed is not an error: it simply means there is nothing to take over.

entries.reason: Rapport owns persistent aftermath; CumOverlays' own timer would remove it early
